title.en: International Organisations (Immunities and Privileges) (International Monetary Fund) Order 2008

completenessNote: 全文，共 7 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the International Organisations (Immunities and Privileges) (International Monetary Fund) Order 2008.

heading.en: Immunities and privileges in addition to those previously conferred

text.en:
3. This Order does not affect —
(a)the Bretton Woods Agreements Order 1966; and
(b)every other written law which sets out the status, immunities and privileges of the Fund, or any of its officers and employees, for the purpose of giving effect to the Articles of Agreement of the Fund.
4. The International Monetary Fund is an organisation of which the Government and the governments of foreign sovereign Powers are members.

heading.en: Immunities and privileges of Fund in relation to Resident Representative Office

text.en: 5. The Fund has, in relation to the Resident Representative Office, the like inviolability of its premises as is accorded in respect of the premises of an envoy of a foreign sovereign Power accredited to the Republic of Singapore.

heading.en: Immunities and privileges of members of professional staff of Fund
Non-application of Part 4 of Second Schedule to Act

text.en: 7. Part 4 of the Second Schedule to the Act does not apply to extend any immunity or privilege conferred by this Order to any person.
